title: runners*.toml comments still state the old cloud rule
description:
The rule is now 'no per-token billing in the cloud', but the tracked routing files still say 'nothing in the cloud runs claude' / 'the cloud runs Workers AI models only' (.tick/runners.cloud.toml:6-7 and :79, .tick/runners.toml:61, and the [roles.review] frontier-tier comments). The CELLS are correct (the default stays Workers AI; the rung is off unless a config selects it), so nothing behaves wrongly — but a reader of the files that route this repository's own runs is told a rule the code no longer enforces. I did not edit them: .tick/runners.cloud.toml is outside the files a worker may write, and the wording is an operator statement of their own rule.
evidence: .tick/runners.cloud.toml:6-7,79; .tick/runners.toml:61
